proposed.text: Per PD 1096, Rule XII, Section 1214.3, projection room exit doorways must comply with which of the following requirements?

options.text: Minimum 2 doorways, each ≥ 900 mm wide × 2,000 mm high, swinging inward, with panic hardware
Minimum 2 doorways, each ≥ 750 mm wide × 2,000 mm high, self-closing 3/4-hour, swinging outward, with no latches
Minimum 2 doorways, each ≥ 900 mm wide × 2,100 mm high, self-closing 1-hour, swinging outward, with deadbolt locks
Minimum 1 doorway, ≥ 900 mm wide × 2,000 mm high, with self-closing 1-hour fire assembly

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: The no-latch rule is critical for life safety — in an emergency, panicked occupants must be able to push through without operating any hardware. The outward swing maximizes egress speed. The 1/3 perimeter separation between exits ensures that a fire affecting one exit does not simultaneously block the other.
